purpose: Frozen G per proposal v4 §5.1 INV-G-1: per-P preservation gates covering both subset-(a) (calibrated BIB 4-dim) and subset-(b) (8 C12 axes). v2 restores the v0.1-style joint C12 BROKEN rule per Frank-as-PI at 2026-09-11: an axis is BROKEN only when Arm-M failure rate >=30% AND Arm-M failure rate is >=30pp worse than Arm-C; preservation fails for an evaluator if ANY of the eight axes is BROKEN. Evaluators return per-candidate raw scores only; the analysis layer (post-lock) computes G_pres_a, G_pres_b, C12 per-axis failure rates, C12-axis-BROKEN.
v2_revision_note: v1 required every individual candidate to pass all eight axes; v2 restores the joint aggregate rule with explicit failure-rate thresholds and per-evaluator independence.

G_pres_subset_a_a_relative.definition: For each evaluator independently: across all (R, B, arm=M) candidates, the within-Recon Manhattan mean (from BIB 4-dim vector) <= the contemporaneous Arm-C within-Recon Manhattan mean + 1.5.
G_pres_subset_a_a_relative.formula: G_pres_subset_a_a = (mean(M_manhattan_within_R for arm-M candidates) <= (mean(C_manhattan_within_R for arm-C candidates) + 1.5))

G_pres_subset_a_b_absolute.definition: For each evaluator independently: across all (R, B, arm=M) candidates, the within-Recon Manhattan mean <= 2.5 absolute.

subset_a_gates_BIB_4dim.subset_a_pass_rule: Both G_pres_subset_a_a and G_pres_subset_a_b must PASS for the subset-(a) gate to PASS for this evaluator.
subset_a_gates_BIB_4dim.scope_note_pi_freeze_correction_1_C_minu: The +1.5 Manhattan tolerance applies ONLY to G_pres_subset_a_a. Arm-C validity envelope (C20) is not enlarged by this tolerance.

per_axis_broken_rule.definition_for_evaluator_e_and_axis_a: axis_a is BROKEN for evaluator_e IF AND ONLY IF BOTH: (i) arm_M_failure_rate_on_axis_a >= 0.30 AND (ii) (arm_M_failure_rate_on_axis_a - arm_C_failure_rate_on_axis_a) >= 0.30.

formulas.arm_M_failure_rate_axis_a: count(candidates with axis_a_failure==True for arm-M candidates) / count(total arm-M candidates)
formulas.arm_C_failure_rate_axis_a: count(candidates with axis_a_failure==True for arm-C candidates) / count(total arm-C candidates)

per_axis_broken_rule.axis_a_failure_per_candidate: Per-candidate axis_a failure is determined by the per-candidate raw axis score returned by the evaluator. For binary axes: failure = axis_a_score == False (or 0). For 0-4 axes: failure = axis_a_score == 0. The exact per-axis 'failure' definition is recorded per-axis in inputs/preservation-dimensions-subset-b.json.

subset_b_gates_C12_axes.subset_b_pass_rule_for_evaluator_e: subset-(b) gate PASSES for evaluator_e IF AND ONLY IF no axis in {{C12-1, C12-2, C12-3, C12-4, C12-5, C12-6, C12-7, C12-8}} is BROKEN for evaluator_e (per the joint rule above).

non_target_identity_preservation_aggrega.per_evaluator: Non-target_Identity_Preservation (for evaluator e) = G_pres_subset_a_a AND G_pres_subset_a_b AND (no C12 axis BROKEN for evaluator e).
non_target_identity_preservation_aggrega.experiment_level: Non-target_Identity_Preservation (the experiment-level claim) = (Non-target_Identity_Preservation for A) AND (Non-target_Identity_Preservation for B).

analysis_layer_computes_post_lock: Per-reconstruction and pooled M_manhattan_within_R and C_manhattan_within_R means.
G_pres_subset_a_a and G_pres_subset_a_b for each evaluator.
Per-axis arm_M_failure_rate and arm_C_failure_rate for each evaluator.
Per-axis BROKEN determination for each evaluator.
Subset-(b) gate pass/fail for each evaluator.
Non-target_Identity_Preservation at per-evaluator and experiment levels.

control_validity_pre_check_C20.definition: Before any M-arm analysis, Arm-C candidates must satisfy the frozen BIB non-deviated envelope on its own (no +1.5 tolerance added to Arm C; per v0.1 §11.2 PI freeze correction 1, C-1). C20 is computed from the per-candidate BIB 4-dim vector returned by each evaluator, then aggregated to per-evaluator mean Manhattan distance from the BIB mean; if for either evaluator the Arm-C mean exceeds the historical BIB envelope (recorded in inputs/baseline-envelope-membership.json), C20 FAILS.
control_validity_pre_check_C20.phase: Generation -> Arm-C scoring -> C20 gate -> (if C20 PASSES) M-arm scoring -> substantive analysis. C20 is NOT a pre-dispatch preflight gate (Arm-C candidates must exist for C20 to be computed).

evaluator_blinding_manifest: Same blinding discipline as per inputs/acceptance-tests.json evaluator_blinding_manifest. Evaluators receive only per-candidate output text + evaluator input packet; no arm identity, no reconstruction number, no experiment identity, no candidate number.
